name: Nanopesos
source:
This game is a budget management simulator inspired by the low salaries and high living costs in Chile.

You are a young worker with no children, currently single.
You live in a dark and small studio apartment in the capital.

You feel lucky for having your own place, even though you're paying $200.000 for 17 square meters (183 sq ft). You know that if you lose it, it will be really hard to get another apartment for that price in the capital.

With a monthly wage of $301.000 or $400.000, you need to live trough the month, paying rent, medical care, bills, food and transport.

[From [url=https://laburatory.itch.io/nanopesos]Itch.io[/url] and edited from in-game introduction]
